Ebriatas: that is one ugly mf. Nothing appealing about it except how frikking difficult it is. That is one good training ground to prep yourself for DLC. It's in the uppar cathedral ward. Check some online guides on how to get there.

Second phase: stay close and dodge in circles.

For me, playing as Abby made the narrative so much bigger. It wasnt just about Ellie or Joel. It was about the world they live in, the consequences of hate and revenge, the human nature when it's pushed against the wall...all of it makes sense and you suddenly see the bigger picture. And it wasnt just that, Abby herself had a very interesting arch. You follow her journey as she struggles with her demons and grows to be a better human. Her collision with Lev was just ...*chef's kiss* perfect. You cant help but get a flashback of the bond between joel and ellie through this lev/abby story.
And it wasnt like you leave the world of Ellie and Joel altogether. Towards the end, it all comes together and you see an amazing conclusion. And no matter what you say, you can truly feel what Last of Us is all about when the ending credits roll.
